summary: Your staged changes are no longer lost when the page reloads or the Manager restarts.

fixes.title: Staged changes survive a reload
fixes.text: Pending changes are kept in your browser and put back after a reload, on top of any colleague's commit. The page asks before you leave with uncommitted changes.
fixes.action: Before updating an environment that runs an older version, commit or note your pending changes.

fixes.title: Discarded entries hidden by default
fixes.text: Tick Show discarded to see who discarded queue entries and why.
